proven: The same Next.js route can resolve different initial experiences from request-time cookie state.
The Experience Engine resolves the cookie-selected culture, theme, and motion on the server.
The raw HTTP responses returned status 200 and distinct resolved experience identities.
RTL/LTR direction matched the resolved culture.
scope: Validation was executed in the local Next.js production server setup.
This does not establish behavior for every CDN/cache/deployment topology.
This does not establish universal performance superiority.
